newsitem.title: UK: GOLF-CLARKE HAS THE CHANCE TO GET IN THE FAST LANE.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-CLARKE HAS THE CHANCE TO GET IN THE FAST LANE.

text.p: Racing car enthusiast Darren Clarke has been given the ideal incentive to win a place in Europe's Ryder Cup team.
Clarke has owned a Porsche and driven several racing cars but his great ambition is to have a Ferrari in his garage.
That scenario came a step nearer when his his club sponsors MacGregor promised him a Ferrari 355 if he makes the Ryder Cup team in September and wins at least two matches.

Northern Irishman Clarke, who set a course record 64 in the second round of the English Open on Friday, lies seventh in the European Ryder Cup table and will ensure himself a place at Valderrama against the United States in September if he wins at Hanbury Manor.
"It's very flattering when people keep telling me about my great prospects for the Ryder Cup and making the team will be a big enough thrill," said Clarke.
"But if I can drive away in a Ferrari it will just complete the occasion for me. I love cars and Ferrari has always been top of my shopping list.
